Pika H3 Flex is now available in ComfyUI.

For teams that make video at scale, speed is what lets you iterate. H3 Flex renders a 15-second 768p clip with audio in under 10 seconds.

Key capabilities:

→ Faster than real-time generation
→ #7 on Design Arena (text-to-video)
→ Up to 12 reference inputs per generation
→ Draft at 480p/768p, final output at up to 4K
→ Five separate audio stems for post-production control

Draft fast. Pick the best take. Finish in 4K. All in one node graph.

Try Pika H3 today ⬇️
